name: Stretch Wrapper

rpm.label: Arm speed
rpm.desc: How fast the arm turns while wrapping. The carriage climbs in step with it, so this sets the cycle time, not the spiral.

overlap.label: Film overlap
overlap.desc: How much of each band the next turn of the spiral covers. The carriage climbs with the arm, one film width less this per turn, so the overlap holds at any arm speed. Wrapped loads are usually run at 50-70%.

liftSpeed.label: Carriage speed (m/s)
liftSpeed.desc: How fast the film carriage travels when it is not climbing the spiral: it drops to the base and comes back down from the top at twice this.

baseTurns.label: Base wraps
baseTurns.desc: Turns at the bottom before the climb: the film run down over the pallet boards is what ties the load to its pallet.

topTurns.label: Top wraps
topTurns.desc: Turns at the top of the load before the carriage comes back down.

autoWrap.label: Auto wrap
autoWrap.desc: With no program driving the start tag, wrap a load once it has stood in the station for a moment, and only once. Off, it wraps only on Use.

standHeight.label: Stand height (m)
standHeight.desc: Height of the conveying surface the load stands on. The part stands with its origin on that surface, and its column runs from here down to the floor.

frameColor.label: Frame color
frameColor.desc: Paint of the column, the boom and its knee brace.

armColor.label: Arm color
armColor.desc: Paint of the rotating arm and its mast, the parts that sweep round the load.

showBeam.label: Show beams
showBeam.desc: Draw the station eye and the film carriage eye. Off by default: the carriage eye turns with the arm.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this wrapper to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

startTag.label: Start tag (rising edge)
startTag.desc: Each rising edge starts ONE wrap cycle on the load in the station; holding it true does not wrap again. While a program drives this tag it owns the machine: Use and Auto wrap stand aside.

enableTag.label: Enable tag
enableTag.desc: The wrapper moves only while this is true. Drop it and the arm brakes to a stop where it is and the carriage holds; raise it and the cycle carries on from there. A start while it is false is ignored. Wire it to the safety chain, not to Stop, so a Stop lets the wrap finish. Leave it empty and the wrapper is always enabled.

busyTag.label: Busy tag
busyTag.desc: True from a start until the arm has parked beside the column. Hold the conveyor while it is true: the arm is turning around the load.

doneTag.label: Done tag
doneTag.desc: True once the load in the station is wrapped and the arm is parked, until the load leaves. Carry on down the line when it goes true.

inPositionTag.label: In position tag
inPositionTag.desc: The station eye, across the line just downstream of the wrap axis: true while a load blocks it. Stop the conveyor on it and the load comes to rest centred under the arm.
